acceptanceCriteria: confirmed: Repeated provider_wait or quota_wait transitions at the 64-entry history boundary never append a 65th entry, never persist an invalid record, and return a deterministic fail-closed WORKFLOW_HISTORY_LIMIT_REACHED decision.

confirmed: Every normal transition path either persists a record satisfying the existing history-length and revision invariants or returns a deterministic fail-closed decision without mutating durable state.

confirmed: Records with 63 entries can make one valid transition to 64 entries, while records already at 64 entries remain loadable and cannot self-corrupt under continued provider or quota unavailability.

confirmed: Focused regression tests cover provider and quota outage repetition, the 63/64 boundary, persisted round trips, malformed and hostile values, and preservation of ordinary pre-boundary transitions.

confirmed: No provider SDK, database, queue, scheduler, network, credential, deployment, production write, booking, payment, inventory, pricing, finalized-platform, or architecture-source behavior is introduced.
